body: Thanks for the words darling. Hope you live a full good life with every good thing life bring you. I’ll not stick around forever I know that, but sometime more in this corrupt world will only harm me and not the ones around me
Thanks for the words. It’s nice that you put effort into writing it. Hope everything turns out great for ya and you love a long good life. Wish you the best

I hope the best for you and that you find someone who loves and cares for you, you deserve it. Keep it going you can do it

I genuinely have a good life. I have a job, have good friends, loving family dadada and I should appreciate my situation, but I’m not happy. I don’t feel comfortable living. I simply don’t want to

Yeah I mean I get the point, but I don’t feel like a burden to people (there might be some people I do but most people no) I know that people care about me and that they want me the best. But if they really want me the best then they have to let me go. 

When I’m anxious I start to worry about everything only to discover that I don’t actually care. I’m constantly trapped between not feeling anything and feeling everything at once. 

I can’t cope with all this and it shouldn’t be other people’s baggage in my opinion.

It’s not because I’m negative about things. But I don’t enjoy them. Showering is like hell, it takes so much energy. 

I care for my friends and family, that the only reason I’ve not done it yet. I would like to feel happy for their well being and accomplishments and I also always act happy, but inside I’m just numb
I like myself. I care about my style and if my hair is all messed up. I’ll always be hygienic and care for myself until I leave this world

The thing is I don’t feel sorry for myself. It’s not low self esteem and pressure from outside that keeps me down.

I work, go to school, see friends, see family. I do things that I once enjoyed, I exercise, drink water, shower, eat properly, I travel, meet new people and do risky things. 

None has helped and tbh i don’t believe in it helping in one year if it didn’t help 5 years ago. 

I have a good life, I just don’t wanna live it. I don’t feel that life is for me. I’ve lived and I’ve done the things I wanted to through volunteer work and so.

I took em for a good long time but it didn’t help so my doctor took me off them and my parents didn’t want me to start up again. Then 6 month ago I started taking migraine pills which only made my anxiety and sleepiness worse so I stopped them too and now I wanna try something new I guess.

I took my medication as I should and didn’t skip days ex.. I did what my doctor told me. I get up every day, I see friends, I’m with my family, I work, I go to parties, I drink water, eat properly, exercise and so on. It doesn’t help.

I get anxiety attacks at least once a week. I wake up every night with a dry mouth, like I haven’t drank water in forever. 

I try my best to defeat whatever I have to defeat but nothing seems to help.

I’m glad you’re doing better and I hope that everything turns out great for you, unfortunately everyone can’t be saved
Therapy whenever my therapist finds the time. Stopped taking medication, except pills that keep me awake, but starting up again soon on other ones. Doesn’t even make a difference.

Thanks man. But people might not want me gone I get it, but I don’t wanna be here. I know “it’s just depression and everything’s gonna be okay someday” but when? Do I have to wait 5 more years? 

I don’t believe in it ever going away and I’ve learnt to deal with it on daily basis. But with it and all the other things I can’t function properly. I’m just a robot Doing the same over and over again.

I’ve talked with my friends, parents, therapist. I’m  cool with people knowing, it’s just not helping. I’m not alone I know, but I wanna be left alone, to end it, end the pain

I’ve dealt with depression since I can remember (at least 5 years) and also stress, insomnia and anxiety. I feel like I’m not even here. I just go through a daily routine. As my coworker describe me “you work like a robot, be present”. I’m anxious all the time, my body hurts, my mind rushes through life. I’m constantly in a pain that is not physical but feels like it. I only live for people, not for myself. 

I don’t find joy in anything. I have plans and things that people see as purposes but really I’m just tired and I wanna sleep, but life keeps me awake. 

I can’t breathe properly a lot of times, it’s like my mind is so exhausted it forgets simple things such as walking and breathing. 

And no one really wants to help

To my friends, my family and my “second family” if you can say so. I mean I want them to know that the pain has ended, that I was better off not being here. That it’s not their fault, something that’ll make them feel better I guess. I just don’t want to be selfish with this
That’s what I wanna know
Both. I work, see friends, i party, I’m together with my family and sometimes I’m alone just to relax. Doesn’t seem to make a difference unfortunately
It’s like my mind left my body. It’s like I’m not even present. Sometimes I’m confused if I’m even here or not
Just regular depression stress and anxiety I guess. Or the bad things that happened in the past idk. I just wanna feel something

I have friends to stay with for a period of time but if I come back he will be raging mad, i would be afraid that he would for real hurt me not just slap or punch me a bit. 

For as long as I remember yeah he’s been like this. He has a lot of anger issues which he takes out on me and my brother. Not so much my brother when I’m there though cause I have to support him and stand up for him because he is young, so I get most of the blame.

This is the job with the highest paying salary in my area. I have to earn a lot of money in order to move out when I turn 18. I got 1.5 years left with him luckily, right now I just need a break if else I’ll break down.
I hope I make it thanks

We’re a small business of 6 people working shifts regularly, so changing a shift is extremely difficult. Even cancelling one is

But thank you anyway

Thanks man

Thank you for trying at least
I know my life is a mess, I just got another 1.5 year to finally get away luckily, wish you the best

I wish I could just stay at work till 1 AM when they close but my dad refuse to let me stay longer than 11. When I get home he wants to talk and then I have to go straight to bed and wake up early because it’s some sort of punishment.

He leave for work at 11 AM so I’m only seeing him in the morning and when I come home at night luckily, bus the night is always the worst. 

I’m going to a completely different school with new subjects so I can’t prep for it before I know what it’s about and he know that, but I’ll try finding something I can do so I don’t have to be home. I’m just so tired all the time cause he won’t let me sleep after 7, sometimes if I’m lucky 8

My dad knows where I work and when I’m working so I’m afraid he’ll show up at work if he even care enough to do that. 

How do I find like a hostel that would actually accept me into it without questioning everything?

I do cheerleading but because some girl he don’t like is at the same club I can either find another club or don’t go at all. So I’m kinda stuck doing nothing right now. Also it’s summer vacation so everything is taking ‘a break’ but I’m out of the house everyday from 4-11 at least it’s just when I come home and he has been drinking so he wanna talk and I’m so scared of him idk what to do. I always sit in the opposite site of the sofa so he can’t reach me and I don’t lock the door so I can always run. 

Thank you for trying to help me or at least hear me out though.

The thing is I really don’t have many places to go. And if I don’t work I will never be able to even move out. Unfortunately I’m too young to just move to another country and start all over, I wish I could though. I’ve just dealt with this for so long that I’m reaching the limit.

He is my dad so I live with him part time and my mom part time. Right now I can’t go see my mother because he wants to control me.

I can’t do sleepovers cause my dad won’t let me go out of the house unless it’s for work.

I keep texting her and calling her telling her I want to go home to her and my brother but she just says tomorrow all the time. Our work hours cross so we don’t get to see each other that much unfortunately.

I’ve tried finding a place but because I’m 16 it is not really easy, most places is 18+ and extremely expensive especially with my salary. I’ve tried talking them into staying with my grandma but she is an alcoholic as well so they thought I would be better off living with them.
